title: A low-temperature aqueous Se-based battery with rapid reaction kinetics and unprecedented energy density
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,6180-6190
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE06003B, Paper
Guoqiang Liu, Linyu Hu, Ying Liu, Maowen Xu, Jiajun Guo, Haichuan Zhou, Guoliang Ma, He Lin, Zhenhuang Su, Chang Liu, Jiangqi Zhao, Chunlong Dai, Zifeng Lin
A low-temperature aqueous Zn–Se battery has been developed, achieving a record-breaking energy density of 116 W h kg−1 at −50 °C. The charge storage mechanism of the Se cathode has been clearly elucidated.
